implementedControls.repositoryCleanup: Logout and deletion capture the current client, session and user before waiting for push cleanup; old continuations cannot invoke a replacement client/account/session. Destructive actions are not automatically replayed.
implementedControls.ownedCancellation: Repository invalidation advances its local epoch and cancels only its tracked client-bound mutation scopes. An old repository never dereferences or cancels the newest global client; a newer repository on the same SDK retains its pending operation.
implementedControls.hydrationAndWrites: Profile reads, bootstrap, private contacts and optimistic profile updates capture client/session/epoch, check every continuation and SafeRpc attempt, pin the checked bearer and disable hidden PostgREST builder retries. Foreign user/club profile rows are rejected.
implementedControls.optimisticConflict: The compare-and-set update retains expected updated_at and one attempt; a null match remains an explicit ProfileConflictException without bootstrap fallback.
implementedControls.sameSessionRefresh: The helper accepts continuity only between SDK-held sessions with matching account and access token or nonempty server session_id; it grants no identity or role authority.
implementedControls.notifierScope: Minimal rebuild/disposal hooks invalidate the old captured repository; earlier notifier generation/subscription and successful SDK-event hydration behavior remain covered by the complete package bank.
implementedControls.nativePush: Permission, preferences, token reads, registration and cleanup are scoped by actual SDK session/client, club and latest device generation. Serialized native operations finish before a newer token lookup/registration; stale topic joins are revoked inside the same queue before a newer join.
implementedControls.sdkMutationOrdering: Anonymous sign-in, verifyOTP and updateUser check actual SDK generation/session continuity and the optional repository-owned scope immediately before mutation/event publication. SDK logout/initial session replacement fence older replies; a delayed PKCE cleanup cannot publish signedOut for a newly installed session.

limits: Verification covers the named local packages and source bindings. It does not establish deployed services, devices, stores or provider acceptance.

An HTTP request or native call already accepted by its server/platform cannot be undone by a local epoch. Requests stay bound to their checked account; queued native work prevents the old call from operating on a newer registration.

All original upstream SDK tests/examples are retained and hashed. Publisher test fixtures needing their original local service/dev environment were not invoked; current application-facing SDK regressions use the installed/local patched SDK with intercepted HTTP and controlled native calls.

Module test commands emitted the core_theme material-icon pubspec advisory; tests passed with zero failures or skipped cases. Static analysis of the nineteen owned targets is a separate strict zero-issue gate.
